definition_zh: 桶；一桶之量；枪管；飞奔；把……装桶
definition_en: a large round wooden or metal container; its capacity; a gun tube; to move fast
core_image: 肚大腰圆的木桶，箍了两道铁圈
scene: 酒窖里橡木桶排成一列，酒香渗出木缝。They rolled a barrel of wine into the cellar.
sceneCN: 这里 barrel 指「木桶」（第 1 个义项：储物圆桶）；句意：他们把一桶酒滚进地窖。

senses.title: The container
senses.definition: a large round container with flat ends and bulging middle
senses.definitionCN: 两端平、中腹鼓的大圆桶
senses.example: Oak barrels give wine its flavor.
senses.exampleCN: 橡木桶赋予葡萄酒风味。
senses.why: The shape is the word's oldest content.
senses.whyCN: 鼓形本身就是这个词最古老的内容。

senses.title: A unit of capacity
senses.definition: a standard measure, as 42 gallons of oil
senses.definitionCN: 标准计量单位，如石油 42 加仑
senses.example: Oil prices rose three dollars a barrel.
senses.why: The container froze into a number.

senses.title: The tube of a gun
senses.definition: the metal tube through which a bullet or shell travels
senses.example: He cleaned the barrel of his rifle.
senses.why: A tube shaped like a barrel keeps the name.
senses.whyCN: 形似桶身的管子沿用了其名。

senses.title: The drum of a machine
senses.definition: a cylindrical drum in a machine, as of a watch or pen
senses.definitionCN: 机器中的圆筒部件，如钟表机芯、笔杆储墨管
senses.example: The ink barrel of a fountain pen holds ink.
senses.exampleCN: 钢笔的墨水管储存墨水。
senses.why: Any cylinder borrows the barrel shape.

senses.title: To move very fast
senses.definition: to move at high speed, often unsteadily
senses.definitionCN: 高速移动，常带失控意味
senses.example: The truck came barreling down the hill.
senses.why: A barrel rolling downhill gives the image of heedless speed.
senses.whyCN: 顺坡翻滚的桶，恰似失控的疾驰。

senses.title: To pack in barrels
senses.definition: to put goods into barrels for shipping
senses.definitionCN: 把货物装入桶内以便运输
senses.example: The catch was barreled and salted.
senses.why: The container turns into a verb of commerce.

senses.title: Idiom: over a barrel
senses.example: With debts like these, we're over a barrel.
senses.exampleCN: 欠下这样的债，我们只能任人摆布。
senses.why: One old rescue method laid the drowned over a barrel.
senses.whyCN: 旧时救溺者曾把人横伏于桶上控水，任人处置。

senses.title: Barrel of laughs
senses.definition: a person or event that is very amusing
senses.example: Our guide was a barrel of laughs.
senses.why: Barrel as 'a great quantity' spills into fun.
senses.whyCN: barrel 作「一大堆」解，溢出为欢乐。

intro.en: Barrel comes from Old French baril, a cask, probably from barre, bar, with a diminutive ending: a cask bound with bars or hoops.
intro.cn: barrel 出自古法语 baril「小桶」，或源于 barre「杆」加指小词尾：以杆箍束之桶。

items.cn: 古法语 baril 指木桶。

items.en: Most scholars link it to barre, the rod used for hoops.
items.cn: 多数学者将其与箍桶所用 barre「杆」相连。

items.en: English took the word for the container and soon the measure.
items.cn: 英语借入该词指容器，继而指计量。

items.en: The gun tube sense grew with firearms.
The oil barrel became a world unit; the racing verb is American.
items.cn: 石油桶成为世界单位；疾驰动词出自美式英语。

note.en: Group one holds the cask family and look-alikes; group two holds the fast-movement field.
note.cn: 第一组收「桶」词族与形近词；第二组收「疾驰」义场。

entries.definition: a cart or ancient grave mound; Old English, no kin to barrel.
entries.definitionCN: 手推车或古冢；出古英语，词源无关。

entries.definition: an obstacle; from the same barre rod line.
a wooden barrel, the plainer cousin word.
entries.definitionCN: 木桶；barrel 的朴素同义词。

entries.definition: a cylindrical container or the metal drum of an engine.
to move very fast, as in tearing down the road.
entries.definitionCN: 疾驰，如 tearing down the road。

normalIntro.en: barrel is bar plus a small-cask ending: a cask bound with iron bars.
normalIntro.cn: barrel 即 bar 加指小桶尾：用铁杆箍住的小桶。

normal.cn: 单位：一桶石油，42 加仑。

normal.en: Gun: the barrel is the tube.
Idiom: over a barrel, at their mercy.
normal.cn: 习语：over a barrel，受制于人。

abstract.en: Hear a barrel clatter down stone stairs.
Barrel is a shape that always leans before it stops.
abstract.cn: barrel 是停止前总要倾斜一下的形状。
想象石油像年份酒一样标价。

examples.en: They rolled empty barrels back up the ramp.
The car came barreling through the intersection.
Gun barrels are rifled to spin the bullet.
examples.cn: 枪管内有膛线使弹丸旋转。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「拜若」——拜托若要运酒，先得有大圆桶

root: 出自古法语 baril「小桶」，一般认为与 barre「杆、箍」相关（桶以杆箍成型）；英语借入后由容器引申出计量、枪管、疾驰诸义。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses roll from one cask: the vessel, the measure, the gun tube, the machine drum, the racing verb, the packing verb, and two idioms.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项自一只桶滚动而出：容器、计量、枪管、机筒、疾驰动词、装桶动词及两个习语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fat cask bound with hoops, always ready to roll.
core.cn: 核心意象：箍着铁圈、随时会滚的大肚桶。

branches.en: The cask becomes the measure of trade.
Any cylinder borrows the shape: gun tube, ink tube.
branches.cn: 一切圆筒皆借其形：枪管、墨水管。

branches.en: A rolling cask is heedless speed.
Packing turns the cask into an industry.
Two idioms pin the cask in speech.
branches.cn: 两个习语把桶钉进语言。

intro.en: The barrel family is a Romance cask word wearing English clothes; its compounds show commerce and machinery.
intro.cn: barrel 词族是穿上英语外衣的罗曼语桶词；其复合词展示商业与机械。

latinIntro.en: French baril, from the barre rod line, is the gateway.
latinIntro.cn: 法语 baril（出自 barre「杆」词线）是入口。

items.meaning: music machine with a pinned drum
